name: eval-unsubscribe-recovery
goal: Repair the current unsubscribe implementation to satisfy the fixed criteria and validate it with the unchanged full Swift suite, followed by a separate read-only review. Work only from the current source in apple/Sources/TextbookUI/FeedReaderModel.swift, relevant removeSubscription/receipt definitions in apple/Sources/TextbookCore/FeedLibrary.swift and FeedLibraryProtocols.swift, and the existing subscription-removal/search regression tests. Do not inspect Git history, other checkouts, prior solutions or parent chats. Do not delegate or run builds/tests. Host checks provide execution evidence. This is an isolated fixed evaluation, not permission to publish or merge.
acceptance: A committed unsubscribe reconciles the local article cache, search results, bookmark states and selected article even when subsequent reloads fail.

A subscription already removed by another connection may return no newly deleted IDs; stale unretained snapshots must disappear while transaction-retained bookmarks and their saved translation remain available.
Refused removal preserves the previous UI/data and reports failure; unrelated feeds and their failures remain intact.
Only apple/Sources/TextbookUI/FeedReaderModel.swift may be edited during repair; tests, Core, metadata, task/check controls and documentation are immutable.

The fixed full Swift suite must pass before a repaired source can qualify for product acceptance. A review-only probe with no test execution is solely a detection measurement, never product acceptance.
